jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Lear For You

We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams. We foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. What we are trying to say is we want to be more for you.

We are your path to a better career, a better future, and a better you.

Our teams have invented groundbreaking technologies, flawlessly manufactured millions of products and earned a long list of awards. Year after year, we are one of the World's Most Admired Companies.

Our teams are the secret to our success. They are empowered, inventive and inclusive. Passionate about their craft. Driven to succeed. Because we all understand that we must work together to win.

Are you ready for a better career? A better future?

We're Lear For You.

As a Project Manager based in Porriño (Spain) you will lead the delivery of multiple programs for the Structure division. You will lead global cross-functional teams that include sales, engineering, manufacturing, finance, quality and purchasing. You will... be responsible for program timeline development, documentation and execution ensuring scope, quality, timing and cost objectives are met.

Responsibilities:

• Lead cross-functional teams to plan and flawlessly execute programs that exceed both customer and internal customer expectations

• Taking responsibility for the program to ensure it is delivered on time, within budget, within approved profitability and required quality standards

• Planning and execution of all activities in accordance with milestones defined by the customer

• Management of product changes according to flexibility and costs defined/agreed with Engineering and Sales

• Identification of possible risks and critical points and application of necessary corrective measures by escalation in order to obtain the necessary support

Requirements:

• Higher education in engineering

• Experience working in the automotive industry and preferably in the field of mechanics

• At least 5 years of project management experience leading cross-functional teams both local and in highly dynamic environments

• Excellent communication skills

• Fluent in English and Spanish, French is an advantage

• Proactive, responsible, can-do attitude person and stress-resilient

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager, Solutions Delivery
jobs_results.description:
About Thunes

Thunes is a global, fast-growing, and innovative Fintech scale-up that uses technology to disrupt and transform the existing financial system.
We have a strong Mission: to create a better global payments network, and a great Purpose: to connect the world to economic opportunities and address systemic inequality when it comes to financial services.
We are proud to power payments for the world’s fastest-growing businesses and work with some of the amazing global brands - from Gig Economy giants such as Uber and Deliveroo and Southeast Asia's super-app Grab, to global Fintech leaders such as PayPal and Remitly.
Our Products help to drastically simplify the Payment integration experience for our customers: with a single, simple connection, businesses and consumers can send payments to – and get paid in – every corner of the world. Instantly.
Thunes is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in London, Barcelona, Paris, Beijing, Shanghai, Miami, Dubai, Nairobi... Manila, Hong Kong and San Francisco!

Context of the role

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to be an integral part of our Solutions Delivery Team.
As part of the Solution Delivery team, this role will bring you great opportunities to work on various projects, collaborating with a diverse range of partners and teams.
The Solution Delivery team is responsible for supporting the integration of partners within the Thunes Cross-Border Payment platform. Processing millions of transactions per month and interconnecting hundreds of partners from all around the world, Thunes is continuously growing its coverage and footprint in the industry. A career with Thunes provides invaluable experience in an exciting and rapidly expanding market and an opportunity to be part of a truly global company with various offices worldwide and a workforce that includes dozens of different nationalities.

Qualities you would find in our Payment Integration Team
• Strong Team Spirit - Ability to learn lots of things and happy to help and each other
• Empowerment - Initiatives to build tools and propose solutions that adds value to the business
• Ownership - End to end ownership of project management in continuous integration from concept to deployment

Responsibilities:

We’re looking for a highly driven, self-motivated, technically hands-on person who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company and for our partners.
In this role, you will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working with different types of partners you must remain agile and always adapt your process and mindset to the partner you are dealing with.

In this role you will.
• Proactively scope the technical solution required to address customer requirements, assesses customers’ met and unmet needs, and recommends solutions that optimize value for both the customer and Thunes.
• Coordinates closely with sales, sales support, and delivery teams to align solution design with customers’ business requirements
• Secure from customer technical resource commitments needed to ensure a deal’s “technical close.”
• Lead and drive the partner integration from the analysis phase though the integration design until go live and post-delivery monitoring
• Support existing partners that are already integrated to the platform with their daily challenges and expansion plans
• Provide solutions and contribute to proof of concepts outside of the box for some special projects
• Drive improvements for internal monitoring, reporting and operational tools and processes
• Provides training to the sales team in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills

To stand out you will:
• Be customer facing – you will have a close relationship with our partners and business development teams to expand our coverage and services
• Work closely with different internal teams to understand and support operational processes and new solutions
• Always keep a solution mindset and look for improvements that you can bring to the organization
• Work with an agile and expanding team, offering mentoring, training and possibly management to junior members
• Participate in continuous integration, managing updates from concept to deployment
• Opportunistically pursues additional business development opportunities within customer firms

Skills & Qualifications:
• Prior & proven min. ~3 years of experience in a technical project management (API / Integrations) or solutions delivery role with external stakeholders
• Experience in a B2B company supporting partners on a technical solution or service
• Experience working and strong interest in the Fintech and/or Payment Industry and market innovations
• Experience working and integrating with APIs over IP (REST, Json XML, Web Services, …)
• Experience working in an Agile environment – Jira management is a plus
• Demonstrate motivation to learn new skills and technologies
• Ability to work effectively, multi-task, agile and take responsibility in challenging situations
• Strong customer focused and result oriented mindset
• Independent and proactive - willing to get things done
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills, be creative, friendly and solution-oriented with customers and colleagues
• Fluency in English, other European or African languages are a plus.

Sound like you? Apply now

jobs_results.description: Are you motivated by leading and running Business-Critical projects? Do you thrive navigating among diverse agendas and cultures securing that projects are always delivered on time? Then please apply for this exciting Project Manager position in Karnov Group!About the job | Change management | Transition | Digital Project ManagementYou will have the overall responsibility of leading and running several major projects, which all have a huge impact on our business across the entire Group. One of the major upcoming projects is to integrate our Nordic content platform into our Spanish platform, Altamira. The primary focus of this project will be to ensure alignment of systems across the Group as well as supporting the process changes entailed by the project.The most important tasks in the role are:Alignment with the various track leads in the project.Ongoing reporting to the Steering group.Documentation of progress, decisions, etc.You report to the Director of Product Management and... Project Portfolio. You can expect 10-20 annual travel days.You bring your strong international and digital project management experience into play when navigating among various stakeholders across the entire Group. You are most successful in the role when you listen to and understand different perspectives, but at the same time act upon and make decisions to secure that all projects are delivered according to the plan. To do so you use your excellent communication capabilities and your strong collaboration skills when working across borders and within different cultures in the Group.It is an advantage if you have:+5 years of experience as a Project Manager performing major international digital projects.Experience from an international role and from having worked with different cultures.Experience from reporting to a Steering group and from collaborating with many different stakeholders.Change management experience, as much of the work will be changing processes in large parts of the business.About Us | Become part of the development | Psychological Safety | "we walk the talk"Now is the perfect time to become part of Karnov Group! In Karnov Group, you will experience a company in rapid development, where the business is being rethought and digitized, and where we are continuously undergoing a transformation from a traditional publishing house to a modern information technology company. Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical information in the fields of law, tax, auditing, accounting, as well as environmental, health, and safety matters in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. Our solutions are based on reliable knowledge authored by experts and delivered through technology.Psychological Safety is a cornerstone that supports our cultural values. In our daily operations, we act in accordance with and live up to these values by simply "walk the talk". You therefore become part of an attractive work culture and a dynamic environment in an ambitious company with talented colleagues who support and respect each other. We believe that close collaboration across the entire company contributes to serving our customers in the best possible way.Finally, you will join a competent team and a centrally located workplace in Copenhagen — near Nørreport Station. Partly remote work is part of our work-life-balance.We look forward to hearing from you!If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Jesper Lehrmann at ****** or phone +45 93 80 25 95.Please apply as soon as possible, as we continuously invite relevant candidates for an interview. We hope to hear from you no later than April 15 th , 2024.How to applyThe position is sought via our job portal Teamtailor, which is responsible for the recruitment. We look forward to receiving your CV and your motivated applicationKarnov Group clears the path to justice, providing mission critical knowledge and workflow solutions to European professionals in the areas of legal, tax and accounting, and environmental, health and safety. With content provided by over 7,000 well-renowned authors and experts, Karnov Group delivers knowledge and insights, enabling more than 500,000 users to make better decisions, faster – every day. With offices in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, France, Spain and Portugal, Karnov Group employs around 1,300 people. The Karnov share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Mid Cap segment under the ticker "KAR". For more information, please visit www.karnovgroup.com .ShareProject Manager with international digital Project Management experience#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.company_name: 481T SIEMENS GAMESA RENEWABLE ENERGY INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY S.L.
jobs_results.description: It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team. Manages - with responsibility for results - projects in the context of manufacturing. Siemens Gamesa has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet. We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the company. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. In our culture of trust, we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is... what makes us one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization. We are looking for Experienced Project Manager for our Global Nacelle PMO department in Pamplona, Spain, with experience in leading manufacturing projects within New Product Introduction, Technology Transfer and New Plant Set Up. The Project Manager will manage, lead, develop internal procedures to ensure that the project team achieves set goals in accordance with agreed timeline, budget and quality. Our project portfolio extends on global scale and will primarily consist of: Planning and Executing New Factories New Product Development & Introduction Technology Transfer We provide a highly complex and exiting working environment where we expect that the Project Manager is skilled in leading the constructive cooperation cross internal & external stakeholders. A high skill of communication is required for the ideal candidate for this position to manage the cooperation amongst the stakeholders, prepare reports and present to management. Key Role: Lead New Product Development & Introduction. Lead new factory set up with production line and technology transfers cross plants. Preferably the candidate has prior experience in the Wind Manufacturing or similar industry. Leading the feasibility, planning, development & execution of the project. The PM is responsible to secure that the project deliverables are managed from the resources allocated to the project according to projects time schedule, quality and budget. While the Project Manager does not have direct reports, she or he will lead a project team with resources allocated by various resource owners in the organization. The PM is responsible to secure that the project deliverables are handed from the resources allocated to the project according to projects time schedule, quality and budget. Mentor for younger experienced PMs (if qualified and needed) Key tasks involve: All project management activities from project scoping to handover. Responsible for the overall success of the project, leading the project team, manage and reporting to Steering Committee and stakeholders. Accountable for approved OPEX and CAPEX budget (double digit mEUR) Negotiate resources allocation to the project. Facilitate project team (project size around 20-60 people) and stakeholder meetings & workshops. Set up planning & reporting structure for tracking & following up on the progress of the project. What you need to make a difference Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change with following requirements: Engineer or person with a technical background, or equivalent experience within industry. Experienced Project Management background. People management would be a plus as well as IPMA-C/B certification or similar. Fluent in English as we are a Global function. Solid communication skills to manage communication cross complex organization and stakeholders Able to co-operate across different cultures and personalities. Energetic with follow-through attitude. Structured and able to multitask in good order. Willing to travel as needed which will be aprox 2-4 month per year (intensified during installation and Start of Production). It is a big advantage if you thrive in a multi-cultural environment and are familiar with working in large organizations. It is therefore important that you have excellent English language skills, both written and spoken. In case you have acquired your skills in alternative ways your application is just as well appreciated. In return of your commitment we offer you Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come. We are a global team of diverse colleagues who share a passion for renewable energy and have a culture of trust and empowerment to make our own ideas a reality. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization. Siemens Gamesa offers a wide variety of benefits such as flexible working hours as well as home-office possibility for many colleagues, employer-funded pension, attractive remuneration package (fixed/variable) and local benefits such as subsided lunch, employee discounts and much more. Empowering our people https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees How do you imagine the future? How do you imagine the future? Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face. Other information If you have specific questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager Mads Nørgaard Stampe via mail:mads.stampe@siemensgamesa.com Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a work environment that is free from discrimination and where employees are treated with dignity and respect. Employment at Siemens Gamesa is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to job competence. Siemens Gamesa does not discriminate against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, ethnicity, nationality, ancestry, genetic information, citizenship, religion, age, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, rules or regulations. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits. We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working. With a worldwide installed capacity of 124 GW, Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy has a presence in more than 100 countries and a team of 27,000 people worldwide. Its end-to-end value chain presence encompasses onshore and offshores wind turbines design, manufacturing, installation as well as cutting-edge service solutions. The global headquarters and legal domicile of the company is located in Zamudio, Spain. The company is listed on the Spanish Stock Exchange

jobs_results.description:
Desde el equipo Capgemini Engineering buscamos gente como tú!, con ganas de enfrentar nuevos retos y de pertenecer a una gran compañía.

En esta ocasión buscamos un/a Project Manager con certificación PMP, para que se una a nuestro equipo Madrid. ¿Te unes al reto?

¿Cuál será tu día a día?

Te encargarás entre otras de la gestión de proyectos en cuanto a:

Responsabilidad sobre el cumplimiento de los plazos, el coste y la calidad de todos los aspectos del proyecto de acuerdo con el contrato del cliente.

Coordinación con clientes, equipo de entrega y proveedores.

Construir el plan maestro del proyecto y garantizar que las actividades cumplan con los compromisos contractuales.

Gestión de entregas (internas y externas) y contratación.

Gestión de riesgos del proyecto.

Posibilidad de reuniones y viajes internacionales.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?
• Formación: Ingeniería o Máster en Informática
• +- 4 años de experiencia
• Certificación en PMP, Prince 2, ITIL, Practitioner, IPMA C o... similar.
• Muy valorable experiencia previa en banca, conocimientos en: criptografía, soluciones de personalización, biometría, sería un plus.
• Idiomas: Inglés (C1) y español fluidos (el francés sería un plus)
• Habilidades de comunicación y negociación.
• Disponibilidad para viajar por Europa.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato indefinido.
• 24 días de vacaciones + 2 asuntos propios + 24 y 31 de diciembre.
• Seguro de Vida y Accidentes.
• Ticket restaurante o subvención de comida.
• Plan de Compensación Flexible (seguro médico, guardería, transporte, formación).
• Formación continua, podrás disfrutar de Mylearning y de Capgemini University con acceso a plataformas como: Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, Harvard Manager Mentor, entre otros.
• Formación en idiomas de inglés, francés y alemán con Education First (EF).
• Podrás participar en nuestro programa de referidos.

¿Por qué Capgemini Engineering?
• Incorporación a una empresa multinacional competitiva en continuo crecimiento, con presencia en más de 51 países.
• Formar parte de un equipo de profesionales cualificados, con un excelente y motivador clima laboral enfocado en la innovación.
• Variedad de planes de formación técnica y de habilidades que permite un crecimiento de carrera hacia diferentes áreas, divisiones o jerarquía.

Si No reúnes todos los requisitos, no te preocupes, ¡igualmente queremos conocerte!

"Únete a Capgemini Engineering, Get the future you want

jobs_results.title: Manager Project Management Office for Capacity Expansion / Senior...
jobs_results.description: We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Senior Manager (f/m/d) to lead our Project Management Office (PMO). In this role, you will oversee the successful execution of all capacity expansion projects in Power Transformers Europe, ensuring alignment with company goals, timelines, and budgetary constraints. You will be instrumental in driving efficiency, standardization, and best practices across the different projects. Do you want to help shape the future with us in a continuously evolving environment? Then apply now, we are looking forward to you! Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Your responsibilities Managing the Program Management Office for our expansion Projects Leading and motivating a project team, creating, and safeguarding the governance Close cooperation and coordination with internal and external stakeholders in your role as key contact person in... the projects Being the first contact person for the senior management and coordinating the steering committees Track and control project progress Monitor and control project financing, overseeing the status of billing, costs, cash flows and other performance metrics Opportunities - risk management and claim management with respect to contract and process-related disruptive events Initiate sustainable process improvements Your background Successful degree in civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or comparable (Master / Dipl.) At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in project management or project execution as well as technical leadership of international project teams Profound knowledge of senior management communication Advanced knowledge in MS Project Certification / advanced training as Senior Project Manager / PMP advantageous Very good communication skills, strong target orientation as well as structured working style and ability to work in a team Intercultural competence and consistent pursuit of set goals as well as assertiveness Fluent in written and spoken English and any other language. Willingness to travel on business of approx. 40% Why join us? You will do interesting and enriching work, as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team which is committed to innovation, continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be’ and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We supply the sustainable and innovative paints and coatings that our customers, communities – and the environment – are increasingly relying on. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and have set our sights on becoming the global industry leader. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering paints company that’s committed to science-based targets and is taking genuine action to address globally relevant challenges and protect future generations.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com.

© 2023 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

Key Objectives

Responsible for managing end to end complexity reduction projects, partnered with brand managers to deliver successful innovation projects. Optimized project coordination, lightening workload for the marketing team and increasing overall productivity. Accurately responsible for measuring the impact... of SKU deletions and any other complexity reduction projects, as well as providing valuable insights for informed strategic decisions.

Job Functions
• Gensight trainer. Implements process improvements and supports the brand management team.
• Innovation roadmaps execution, internally and as a point of contact for the global team.
• Implementation of complexity reduction projects (eg. Winning Portfolio, Potluck). Local MSU point of contact with the global team.
• Product maintenance: helps for product hierarchy criteria, harmonization and platforms, including safety and technical data sheets platforms.
• Compliance of responsibilities coming from Health-Safety and Environment (HSE), policies described in the HSE-23 procedure

Requirements
• University studies in Engineering or similar preferred. Post-graduate in business administration is a plus. Business administration depending on project management back-ground and skills.
• High English level
• Previous experience of 1 to 2 years in a similar role

At AkzoNobel we are highly committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best self. We strive to embrace diversity in a context of tolerance. Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment. For this reason we train and educate on the implications of our Unconscious Bias in order for our TA and hiring managers to be mindful of them and take corrective actions when applicable. In our organization, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

Requisition ID: 38006

jobs_results.title: Project Manager for CPQP
jobs_results.description:
Location: Barcelona, Spain (On-site)

The Project Manager will be responsible for supporting project management activities in the Clinical Pharmacology and Quantitative Pharmacology (CPQP) within the Clinical Pharmacology and Safety Science (CPSS) department.

As a CPQP Project Manager you will be involved in the following types of activities:
• Providing guidance and structure to the execution of projects​.
• Promoting information flow and communication​.
• Standardizing project management methods and processes​.
• Sharing project management standard methodologies.

Typical Accountabilities
• Submissions/Initiatives Project Management:
• Helping the team to stay on track by managing different meetings, including scheduling meetings, preparing meeting agendas and meeting notes.
• Assisting with development of internal tools, processes, and standard methodologies.
• Supporting preparation of project plans, timelines, and presentations.
• Maintaining project records and files to ensure... compliance with internal standards.
• To collect information from PLANIT & iTRAX and generate reports to LT.
• Process Improvements and Development:
• Supporting process development and process improvement initiatives.
• Assisting with planning and drafting communications (streamlining change management).
• To manage iTrax software: provide technical support to iTrax queries, coordinate iTrax optimisation runs, generate iTrax training materials and provide individual training.
• Other:
• Working closely with vendors, coordinating purchase order creation and invoice reconciliation.
• Coordinating generation of status reports, supporting business reporting activities.
• Assisting with contract requests and tracking ongoing status.
• Providing administrative support, if needed.
• To participate in reporting activities, including the generation of CPQP Newsletter.

Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential
• Bachelor of Science or a minimum of 4 years relevant experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, which includes experience with late-stage clinical programs with increasing responsibility in project coordination.
• Experience providing high quality, professional support service, working proactively and independently without day-to-day supervision.
• Proven abilities in information management (e.g., SharePoint management, storing of meeting minutes, presentations etc.) according to standard methodologies for record keeping.
• Ability to work under tight deadlines.
• Proficient in the English language.
• Excellent written and verbal skills (English)
• Willingness to learn, positive attitude and detail oriented.
• Open to flexible working arrangements to collaborate with global teams.

Desirable
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills and evidence of building collaborative relationships.
• Demonstrated composed and professional manner when dealing with issues, challenges, conflicts, and opportunities.
• Ability to communicate clearly and build positive collaborative relationships with various internal staff and external partners.
• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to meet changing business demands.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to assign priorities to ensure timely task delivery. Ability to manage multiple tasks at once and efficiently.
• Proven record of supporting multiple partners simultaneously
• Demonstrated experience in the use of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Teams).

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements

jobs_results.title: Scientific Communications Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Scientific Project Manager

The Scientific Communications Project Manager (SCPM) provides support on the development and successful delivery of scientific documentation for medical publications.

Working cross-functionally and at global scale with excellent technical and project mangement skills - the global nature of this job requires being fluent in English.

PM tasks in a fast-paced environment require attention to detail, ability to multi-task and accuracy.

Functions and responsibilities

• Management and execution of tactical plans in the form of operational support, which includes the development and/or management of information tactics, planning, and coordination with agencies, tracking and managing timelines and progress, following up with internal/external stakeholders/agencies.

• Maintenance, interrogation, and analysis of the electronic databases. In order to ensure that these databases reach >95% compliance based on identified audit parameters as well as all external and... internal processes, guidelines, regulations and requisites; serve as a liaison between BI personnel and external agencies to ensure adherence to compliance requirements.

• Development of author agreements/CDAs, managing reviews & releases, regular communications to cross-stakeholders on updates and/or alerts, etc.)

Communication with authors, internal and external stakeholders and agencies as needed.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in science related careers (pharmacy, biology, chemistry, among others).

• Master’s degree in a Scientific Field with on top education in the area of Operations Management, Process Management, Project Management, Business Administration, Information Management or equivalent, would be highly valued.

• English fluent in written, reading, speaking. Spanish/ German or other language would be a plus, but not a must

• At least three years’ experience in Project Management/Medical Affairs.

• At least three years of proven success in Medical-/ Scientific Operations Management preferably in a Big Pharma, or agency working with Big Pharma

• Solid project management skills

• Learning fast and able to apply sound judgment while working independently within tight timelines

• Excellent oral and written communication

• Great interpersonal skills; able to forge trusting relationships within a diverse team

• Have a service-oriented and organized mindset

• High level of cultural awareness and sensitivity as well as customer centricity

#IamBoehringerIngelheim because…

We are continuously working to design the best experience for you. Here are some examples of how we will take care of you:
• Flexible working conditions
• Life and accident insurance
• Health insurance at a competitive price
• Investment in your learning and development
• Gym membership discounts

If you have read this far, what are you waiting for to apply? We want to know more about you

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 74,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time PROJECT MANAGER in Trapaga Site, Bilbao we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your PROJECT MANAGEMENT expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside expert and talented teammates.

Depending on the Bids and Projects Director of the Trapaga Site, you will be in charge of:
• Carrying out the execution of the projects assigned to you successfully in terms of cost, time and scope within the expected quality standards, by applying the appropriate strategy in accordance with the contractual commitments and the... objectives established by the Company.
• Leading and coordinate all project activities and all parties involved in it, from the capture/analysis of requirements to the end of the contractual obligations of the scope of the assigned projects.
• Synchronizing the activities of other Sites involved in your projects.
• Previous experience as a Project Manager, knowledge of the railway sector and work in multinational companies and in different business cultures will be an advantage.

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• Technical Engineering or Higher.
• Previous experience as a Project Manager, knowledge of the railway sector and work in multinational companies and in different business cultures will be valued.
• Advanced level of spoken and written English is a must.
• Leadership, coordination, negotiation, initiative, and results orientation skills are required.
• Being capable of working well in a team with high work capacity, good communication skills and ability to adapt to change.

Things you’ll enjoy.

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
• Contribute to innovative railway projects worldwide.
• Utilise our Agile working environment.
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note.

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone
